S.FORM: alang Lkuxan ga niya mki sku Sincik Keng atu Nahuy go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 11 buwan, 18 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 72% kyan ku 13 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 28% kyan ku 5 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 61%, Paywan 6%, binah lihuyan s'uli 6%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Lkuxan hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay 'zil na Lkuxan hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Lkuxan hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Lkuxan hya' ga llyung. tay 'zil na Lkuxan hya' ga Mklapay. tay 'llaw na Lkuxan hya' ga Pololan. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ lkuxan ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku [s|ɕ]in[ʦ|ʨ]ik keŋ atu naħuj ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan ** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku * ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** pajwan * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na lkuxan ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na lkuxan ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na lkuxan ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na lkuxan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj ʔzil na lkuxan ħjaʔ ɣa mklapaj taj ʔllaw na lkuxan ħjaʔ ɣa pololan reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
